handoff.summary: FND-2 complete: installable PWA manifest with generated 192/512/maskable icons, prompt-mode service worker registration, app-shell precache, and an explicit Refresh/Later update prompt gated by unsaved edits. All required validation commands pass, including the production build and full unit suite.
decisions: Kept relative Vite base and relative manifest start_url/scope for GitHub Pages portability.
Used prompt mode with injectRegister disabled so src/pwa.ts owns registration and activation requires explicit confirmation.
Added a small unsaved-changes registry in src/pwa.ts for feature forms to gate activation.
Aliased virtual:pwa-register to a test stub in vitest.config.ts so component tests can drive waiting-worker behavior.
Set includeManifestIcons false to avoid duplicate precache entries while glob patterns cache the icons once.
Manifest theme colors are provisional literals; ui-engineer owns final locked tokens in FND-5.
